g.text: Munin: the Synology that backs storage for the whole lab
One DS223J, one RAID1 pool, carved into volumes by purpose. A hard DSM-wide iSCSI LUN cap shapes everything.
the k8s-nfs share: every nfs-client volume
plus the one surviving iSCSI LUN class
NFS sizes are advisory: the volume is the ceiling
shared folder media (NFS), exported per client
~10 iSCSI LUNs for the whole DSM:
that cap is why K8s storage is tiered.
One LUN per PVC, so iSCSI is kept for
DSM Tailscale package: subnet router for out-of-band access
authkey minted in the UI, kept in 1Password only
Sources: docs/services/synology.md, docs/procedures/storage-tiering.md. Databases never run on NFS; VM disks live on local LVM-thin, not here.
